# WALL & DECO Prayagraj Studio

> Turnkey interior design, modular kitchens, PVC/WPC fluted panels, and acoustic uPVC windows in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh.

For comprehensive documentation, see [Full LLM Context](https://interior-designer-iota-three.vercel.app/llms-full.txt).

## About
WALL & DECO is a premier interior architecture studio and material supplier located at Chowk, Garhi Sarai, Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh 211003. Open daily until 10:00 PM.

## Core Services & Products
- [Turnkey Interior Design](https://interior-designer-iota-three.vercel.app/interior-design-prayagraj): Complete end-to-end design and execution for living rooms, bedrooms, and lighting.
- [PVC & WPC Wall Panels](https://interior-designer-iota-three.vercel.app/pvc-wpc-wall-panels-prayagraj): Fluted charcoal louvers, exterior WPC cladding, and high-gloss UV marble sheets.
- [Modular Kitchens](https://interior-designer-iota-three.vercel.app/modular-kitchen-prayagraj): 100% boiling waterproof BWP HDHMR carcasses, acrylic & PU shutters, and Blum hardware.
- [uPVC Windows & Doors](https://interior-designer-iota-three.vercel.app/upvc-windows-doors): Double-glazed multi-chamber profiles offering up to 40 dB noise cut and weatherseals.
- [Project Portfolio](https://interior-designer-iota-three.vercel.app/portfolio): Verified concepts and executed spaces across Civil Lines, Tagore Town, Lukarganj, Naini, and Jhalwa.
- [Showroom & Booking](https://interior-designer-iota-three.vercel.app/contact-showroom): Book a free site measurement visit or visit our Chowk experience center.
